title: Pale treeline (Unsplash)
author: Cole Patrick
changes: Cropped to the treeline, converted to greyscale and inverted, levels raised so the sky drops out and the far trees stay part-transparent, used as the alpha channel of a solid near-black fill; resized to 1100px and joined to a mirrored copy so it tiles; WebP with alpha.

title: Lodgepole pine silhouetted in morning fog at Pebble Creek
author: NPS / Jim Peaco (Yellowstone National Park)
license: Public domain (work of the U.S. National Park Service)
changes: Cropped to the tree, greyscale, the fog removed by subtracting a blurred copy (high-pass) and levelling, used as the alpha channel of a solid near-black fill, faded out at the top and towards the ground; resized to 420px; WebP with alpha.
